title: Updating the candidate word
statement: Let $k$ and $l$ be natural numbers, and let $s,u,v,a$ be finite Boolean words. Replacing the word at position $0$ in the host layout for $(s,u,v)$ with $a$ gives the host layout for $(a,u,v)$.
replaced:
For all words $s$, $u$, $v$, and $a$, replacing the word at the candidate
slot of the host layout for $(s, u, v)$ by $a$ yields exactly the layout for
$(a, u, v)$.
